name: digup
title: DigUp
description: Search your Mac by what's in it, all from Raycast: pictures, PDFs, documents, recordings, videos, code, and your iMessage and Beeper chats with their attachments. Runs on DigUp's local EmbeddingGemma 2 index.
author: viraat

commands.name: search-files
commands.title: Dig Up
commands.subtitle: DigUp
commands.description: Describe a file in your own words and dig it up: pictures, screenshots, PDFs, documents, recordings, videos and chats. Start with "code:" to search code.

commands.name: search-messages
commands.title: Dig Up Messages
commands.subtitle: DigUp
commands.description: Search iMessage and Beeper (WhatsApp, Messenger, Discord, LinkedIn…) chats and their attachments by meaning.

commands.name: search-pictures
commands.title: Dig Up Pictures
commands.subtitle: DigUp
commands.description: Pictures, screenshots and video moments as a grid.

commands.name: search-code
commands.title: Dig Up Code
commands.subtitle: DigUp
commands.description: Search the code DigUp has indexed by what it does, or by a name in it.

commands.name: sync-messages
commands.title: Sync Messages
commands.subtitle: DigUp
commands.description: Export new iMessage and Beeper messages and attachments for DigUp to index.

preferences.name: codeEditor
preferences.title: Open Code In
preferences.description: Where code results open, at the line that matched.

preferences.name: digupPath
preferences.title: digup Helper
preferences.description: The digup command-line helper. Leave empty to use the one inside /Applications/DigUp.app.
